about_the_game:
A mystery adventure game packed with absurdist comedy, set entirely within the "Well Done Supermarket"!

Help our hapless protagonist, "Dunkadoo," an employee who is completely out of its depth, launch a hilarious and unpredictable internal investigation following a mysterious threat call. You must act fast to prevent the impending doom! Utilize a clear and intuitive deduction system to uncover the truth and save the staff from a terrible fate.


The Story

Working at the "Well Done Supermarket," the town's one and only grocery store, was fantastic... until the manager received a menacing phone call: "If this one thing isn't fixed, you're all facing impending doom!" Since everyone in town shops here, the incident instantly sent the whole community into high alert.

To solve this absurd crisis, every single employee is now working at 120% capacity! But here’s the problem—our protagonist, "Dunkadoo," is the dumbest fellow in the entire town!

It certainly doesn't want to be the poor soul who gets caught up in the impending doom!

Join Dunkadoo as it deals with quirky customers and investigates seemingly mundane clues that hold the key to this peculiar case.

Game Features

  • A Hapless Bird's Absurdist Comedy Experience a stress-free and humorous approach to the mystery genre, with witty dialogue and absurd situations throughout the investigation.

  • Visualized Deduction System No more messy notes! The game provides a clear and intuitive clue-management interface, allowing you to easily organize complex clues alongside Dunkadoo.

  • A Cast of Quirky Characters From the overly-vigilant manager to the eccentric townsfolk, meet a whole spectrum of bizarre and amusing supermarket employees and residents.

  • Fresh and Unique Hand-Drawn Art A charming hand-drawn art style that makes even the most ridiculous scenes a delight to look at.

  • Find the Box Dog! Follow the cardboard box that mysteriously scoots around the supermarket aisles and find out the truth!

short_description: Welcome to Detective Dunkadoo, an absurdist mystery set in the Well Done Supermarket! Help the hapless Dunkadoo investigate a threat of impending doom. Gather clues, use the visualized deduction board, and follow the weird Box Dog to solve this hilarious case!
